lines.zh: 沼泽的夜路，我一步一黏滑。
lines.en: Every step I take through the night swamp is slick.
Muddy water drips from the hem of my dress.
I close in slowly, step by splash.

lines.zh: 夜色越浓，我走得越轻快。
lines.en: The darker it gets, the lighter I step.

lines.zh: 软泥拖在后面，像一条尾巴。
lines.en: Soft muck trails behind me like a tail.
Hold on, I'll circle around behind you.

lines.zh: 每一步都留下湿滑的脚印。
lines.en: Every step leaves a slick footprint.
I squeeze through the reeds.
Nothing feels better than walking in rotten mud.

lines.zh: 水面一晃，我的倒影就散了。
lines.en: The water ripples and my reflection falls apart.
I slide my body across the shallows.

lines.zh: 那脚步声？只是泥在冒泡。
lines.en: Those footsteps? Just the mud bubbling.

lines.zh: 我在这儿站一会儿，滴答滴答。
lines.en: I'll stand here a while, drip, drip, drip.

lines.zh: 气泡从我的肩头冒出来。
lines.en: Bubbles rise from my shoulder.
The swamp smells wonderful to me.

lines.zh: 我数着蚊子在头顶打转。
lines.en: I count the mosquitoes circling overhead.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，泥会自己流。
lines.en: When I stand still, the mud flows on its own.
My fingers stretch out a little.

lines.zh: 我吐出一个泥泡，又吸回去。
lines.en: I blow a mud bubble and swallow it back.
Waiting for night, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 泥里有什么在动？我看看。
lines.en: Something is moving in the mud? Let me see.

lines.zh: 站久了，脚和地面黏在一起。
lines.en: Standing this long, my feet have stuck to the ground.
You've dirtied my swamp.

lines.zh: 沼泽的污泥里，我浮出半张脸。
lines.en: Half my face rises out of the swamp sludge.
Those boots of yours are mine soon.
You carry a human smell.
Look up and meet these two eyes.
You're standing so far. Come closer.
I tilt my head, and the mud tilts with it.
The swamp mud reaches my waist.
You're shivering. The swamp doesn't.

lines.zh: 直勾勾看着，我不好意思嘛。
lines.en: Staring like that makes me shy.

lines.zh: 你敢打我？泥都溅出来了。
lines.en: You hit me? Mud's splashing everywhere.
Ouch! My shape came apart.
Don't cut me. I'm not fully grown.
That shook the mud right off me.
You sliced a chunk of my mud off.
Gurgle... I'm a bit dizzy.
You're stronger than you look.
Not the face. Faces are the hardest to fix.
I fall, and I'll get up again.
It hurts, but I won't die for good.
The meat you dropped has sunk into the mud.
Is that food? Let me have a lick.
Don't hold it up. Just hand it down.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，是你兜里的。
lines.en: I smell something sweet in your pockets.
I'm not picky. I eat whatever is in the mud.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西晃得我心痒。
lines.en: What you're holding makes my hands itch.
That piece in your hand, toss it to me.

lines.zh: 泥太淡了，需要点别的味。
lines.en: The mud tastes flat. I need something else.
You step back, and the mud follows.
Isn't that for me?
Bump into me and you'll slide away.
Mud's smeared on your legs. Sorry.
I'm soft, but you can't push me.
Don't shove me, bits of me will fall off.

lines.zh: 贴这么近，你衣服保不住了。
lines.en: This close, your clothes are finished.

lines.zh: 擦肩而过，我留下一点毒。
lines.en: We brushed past, and I left a bit of poison.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞得我咕叽一声。
lines.en: Your shoulder knocked a squelch out of me.
I've stuck to you. Can't shake me, can you?
Don't crowd me. The swamp is only so wide.

lines.zh: 碰一下，毒就顺着皮肤爬。
lines.en: One touch and the poison crawls under your skin.

lines.zh: 沼泽里，另一团泥在叫我。
lines.en: Another mound of mud is calling me.

lines.zh: 我们的泥会慢慢合成一团。
lines.en: Our mud will slowly merge into one.
What are you watching? How embarrassing.
He's slipperier than a loach. I like that.

lines.zh: 两个泥泡碰在一起，破了。
lines.en: Two mud bubbles touch and pop.

lines.zh: 等我，我去把泥分他一半。
lines.en: Wait, I'll share my mud with him.

lines.zh: 夜里的沼泽，正适合结伴。
lines.en: The night swamp is perfect for pairing up.

lines.zh: 我们连脚都黏在一起了。
lines.en: Even our feet are stuck together.

lines.zh: 别用剑指着，我们只是聊聊。
lines.en: Don't point that sword. We're only talking.

lines.zh: 明天这片泥里会多一小团。
lines.en: Tomorrow there'll be one more little lump in this mud.
Slimeballs. That's my specialty.
This iron nugget goes into my mud.
You dropped it. Mine now.

lines.zh: 沉甸甸的，藏着好东西吧。
lines.en: So heavy. Something good inside, right?
I pick it up and swallow it slowly.

lines.zh: 铁盒子？留着装我的宝贝。
lines.en: An iron box? I'll keep my treasures in it.

lines.zh: 泥里捞出来的，还带着水。
lines.en: Fished out of the mud, still wet.
I hold the iron nugget in my mouth.
Don't grab it. I touched it first.

lines.zh: 捡东西的声音，咕叽咕叽。
lines.en: Picking things up sounds like squelch, squelch.
Found you, guest of the swamp.
I'll leap over and knock you flying.
Your scent can't hide.
You're tonight's playmate.
I've got my eyes on you. Don't run.

lines.zh: 泥下面，我已经在你脚边。
lines.en: Under the mud, I'm already at your feet.
One gurgle, and I charge.

lines.zh: 你踩进沼泽，就别想干净走。
lines.en: Step into my swamp and you won't leave clean.

lines.zh: 目标是那边那个，慢吞吞的。
lines.en: My target is that slow one over there.

lines.zh: 你转身了，正好，我从这边来。
lines.en: You turned around. Perfect, I come from this side.

lines.zh: 我压低了身子，准备弹出去。
lines.en: I crouch low, ready to spring.
Right now. Locked on.
I can hear your heartbeat.
Don't look back. You'll regret it.

lines.zh: 沼泽把路告诉你，也告诉我。
lines.en: The swamp shows you the path, and it shows me too.
Step by step, you're not getting away.
Mud carries me sliding forward.

lines.zh: 我贴着泥面滑行，追着你。
lines.en: I skim the mud, chasing you.
Don't stop. If you stop, I pounce.
Mud flies when I leap at you.

lines.zh: 再跑远点，沼泽到这儿为止。
lines.en: Run farther. The swamp ends here.

lines.zh: 我绕到你侧面了，看见没？
lines.en: I've circled to your side. See?

lines.zh: 你举盾也没用，我会跳过去。
lines.en: A shield won't help. I'll jump over it.
Poison waits at my fingertips.
You hit a puddle and lost a beat.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，泥也跟着抖。
lines.en: I smile, and the mud shudders too.

lines.zh: 别躲在芦苇后面，太细了。
lines.en: Don't hide behind the reeds. They're too thin.

lines.zh: 你的火把照着我，我不怕。
lines.en: Your torch shines on me. I'm not afraid.
The longer the chase, the more excited I get.

lines.zh: 前面是死水，你走不通的。
lines.en: Dead water ahead. You can't get through.

lines.zh: 我故意放慢，让你以为能逃。
lines.en: I slow down on purpose, so you think you can escape.
Your boots must be full of mud by now.
Three more steps and I can reach you.
The muddy water is already at your knees.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，把你逼进泥潭。
lines.en: Step by step, I herd you into the mire.

lines.zh: 别急，沼泽会替我把你留下。
lines.en: Don't rush. The swamp will keep you for me.
Jumping up, straight into your chest!
This palm carries poison.
A fistful of mud in your face.
You're flying. How does it feel?

lines.zh: 我的手滑进你的护甲缝。
lines.en: My hand slips into the gap in your armor.
Squelch — got you.

lines.zh: 毒会慢慢爬上你的喉咙。
lines.en: The poison will crawl up your throat.
My palm sticks to your armor.
That one knocked you back three steps.
I throw my whole body at you.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍进泥里，拔不出来吧。
lines.en: Your sword sank into my mud. Can't pull it out?
Another hit, and the muddy water splashes.
I grab your wrist. Sticky, isn't it?
You coughed. The poison is working.
Don't block. My fist is soft.
Soft mud can still make your head spin.

lines.zh: 我扑上来的时候，别闭眼。
lines.en: Don't close your eyes when I pounce.
This slap leaves a handprint.
You back off, and I stick to you again.
Does it hurt? That's how it is in the swamp.

lines.zh: 夜来了，我从泥里浮上来。
lines.en: Night falls, and I rise out of the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽打了个嗝，我出生了。
lines.en: The swamp burped, and here I am.

lines.zh: 水面破开，我先露出头发。
lines.en: The water breaks. My hair comes first.
Who stirred the mud? Me.
I crawl out from under the reed roots.
A drop, another drop, and I take shape.
This night is mine.

lines.zh: 泥里有声音，那是我在笑。
lines.en: There's a sound in the mud. That's me laughing.
Don't step on that mud. It's my head.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，全是沼泽的绿。
lines.en: I open my eyes to swamp green.

lines.zh: 月亮照下来，我亮晶晶的。
lines.en: Moonlight falls and I glitter.
Another night, another me.

lines.zh: 火烤得我难受，可我抗得住。
lines.en: The flames sting, but I can take it.

lines.zh: 摔下来？我本来就是一团泥。
lines.en: Fall? I'm a lump of mud to begin with.

lines.zh: 水里我更舒服，淹不死我。
lines.en: Water is comfortable for me. I can't drown.
The blast scatters me everywhere. How annoying.

lines.zh: 箭扎进泥里，拔出来还带毒。
lines.en: The arrow sank in. Pull it out and it's poisoned.
The spell makes me bubble.

lines.zh: 沼泽没什么可吃，我饿得发软。
lines.en: Nothing to eat in the swamp. I'm going limp with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个人都在抖。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole body trembles.
Falling into the void, even mud can't hold on.
